title: TS-60 Retry transient DynamoDB transaction conflicts in turn control (turn stalls about a minute)
description: Reported by the user on develop.chattic.us during iPad testing (the bot got stuck mid-response). Evidence: the TurnExecutor Lambda logged at 02:58:11 UTC TransactionConflictException 'Transaction is ongoing for the item' thrown from DynamoTurnControlStore.beginClosing (conversation/src/store/turn-store.ts) via beginClosing and TurnAttempt.drive; the invocation failed after 4 s, the SQS message was redelivered 56 s later and the turn then finished in 3 s; a FrontDoor SSE stream stayed open 63.9 s waiting. The user had four turns start within about 25 s (rapid messages). Root cause: DynamoDB reports a conflicting concurrent transaction on the same item as a retryable error; the code does not retry it, so it escapes and fails the invocation. Fix: classify transient DynamoDB errors (TransactionConflictException, TransactionCanceledException whose CancellationReasons include TransactionConflict, ThrottlingException, ProvisionedThroughputExceededException, RequestLimitExceeded, InternalServerError) in the turn control store and the other transactional stores (grep TransactWriteItems in conversation/src) and retry the idempotent transition in-process with jittered exponential backoff (a few attempts, a total budget well under the Lambda time, injectable sleep and random for tests); a conditional-check failure (real contention that the code already handles) must NOT be retried; after the budget the error propagates as today. Tests: a cucumber scenario in the turn recovery or attempts feature (new scenario, existing text unchanged) with a store wrapper that fails the first N transactions with the conflict: the turn finalizes in the same invocation; and vitest for the classifier and backoff; mutation checks (no retry, retry conditional failures, unbounded retries). Also check the executor error path: when an invocation fails, how quickly is the SQS message made visible again (SqsRunVisibility; the redelivery took 56 s) and whether a shorter retry is appropriate. Then live-verify is not needed.
right_now_summary: The team is adding retries for transient DynamoDB conflicts to prevent turn stalls.
